exact_edition_year: AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation, 3rd ed. with 2020 and 2022 Interim Revisions
scope_summary: Inspection, evaluation, load rating, fatigue and posting of existing bridges.
overlap: Architecture/data needs are partly covered by SNBI, BIRM and FHWA load-rating guides; exact AASHTO procedures are needed only when producing defensible US-method load ratings.
rationale: Useful for CV 2.6/3.7 but not needed to define the SHM architecture. Buy when the project fixes AASHTO load-rating methodology or must cite its equations/procedures.
